description: Angular component for a marker image settings panel in a widget configuration UI, managing form controls and interactions for marker image settings.

classes.name: MarkerImageSettingsPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for marker image settings panel, handling form initialization, validation, and user interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscriptions for the component.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Hides the popover without applying changes.

methods.name: applyMarkerImageSettings
methods.description: Emits the current form values as marker image settings to parent components.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on the selected marker image type.
